name: Unix Shell
summary: Adversaries may abuse Unix shell commands and scripts for execution. Unix shells are the underlying command prompts on Android and iOS devices. Unix shells can control every aspect of a system, with certain commands requiring elevated privileges that are only accessible if the device has been rooted or jailbroken. Unix shells also support scripts that enable sequential execution of commands as well as other typical programming operations such as…

analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Unix Shell from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events.
